title: The Dining Room People Actually Stay Sitting In
description: Most dining tables end up as a dumping ground. Three fixes — pendant height, clearance behind the chair, and one soft surface — turn it into a room people linger in.
excerpt: You have a table and four chairs, and nobody lasts more than twenty minutes. Usually it's the light height and the wall distance doing it.
content:
Almost every flat has a table. Very few have a dining room anyone wants to sit in. The difference usually isn't the price of the furniture — it's three details you can fix in an afternoon.

## The light hangs too high

The most common mistake: the pendant is left wherever the ceiling wiring sits, roughly two metres off the floor. The light spills across the whole room and the table stops being a place you focus on.

The right height is **55–70 cm above the tabletop**. Yes, the bulb ends up near eye level — that's the point. It creates a pool of light that holds people together. Go for around 2700 K, not 4000 K. Cold light belongs in the utility room, not over dinner.

## Leave 90 cm behind the chair

The second thing nobody measures: the gap between the table edge and the nearest wall or cabinet. You need **75 cm minimum, 90 cm ideally**, so someone can push a chair back and stand up without shuffling sideways.

If the numbers don't work, the answer isn't a smaller table — it's a different shape. A 110 cm round table seats four in a space where a 140×80 rectangle simply doesn't function.

## Add one soft surface

Dining rooms sound empty because everything in them is hard: tile, glass, wood. The echo tires people out before they notice why. A rug under the table (60 cm wider than the top on each side), fabric curtains, or an upholstered bench instead of two chairs. Any one of the three makes conversation at the table noticeably easier.

## Test it on a picture first

Moving a table and recalculating clearances in your head is hard. Upload a photo of the room to [RoomFlip](https://roomflip.io) and generate a few versions: round table instead of rectangular, bench against the wall, lower pendant. Within a minute you'll see whether you still have a walkway.

When you start collecting furniture quotes, [FileTools](https://filetools.eu) helps — merge quotes and spec sheets into a single PDF and keep the whole project in one file.

## The takeaway

Drop the light, keep 90 cm behind the chair, add one soft surface. Three moves, no renovation — and suddenly people stay at the table after the plates are cleared.
